dct_description_sm:
Clipped from Plan of Indian Reserves Musqueam and Chehalis
(https://doi.org/10.58066/srnz-3f57)

Georeferenced map of the Musqueam 2 Reserve at the mouth of the Fraser River north arm clipped from original Plan of Indian Reserves Musqueam and Chehalis (https://doi.org/10.58066/srnz-3f57). Land cover and features described on the map includes Stanlough Creek, Indian houses, potato patches, and timber.
